name: Garden Progeny 1

frame.name: High-Impact Frame
frame.description: Slow firing and high damage. This weapon is more accurate when stationary, moving slowly, and aiming down sights.

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.description:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.description:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

flavor:
Two siblings cleaved by time and space, reflections never found alone,
The ending of the eldritch race—a path long seen but never known.
